title: Tokenised Sukuk: A Verifiable Architecture for Asset Evidence and Programmable Shariah Compliance
abstract: arXiv:2610.33538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Security-token standards such as ERC-3643 decide who may hold a token, not what stands behind it. For a sukuk this gap matters: whether a certificate may trade at a negotiated price depends on what its portfolio contains, and a token that checks only investor identity keeps trading after every non-debt asset has been sold. We ask whether this tradability condition can be enforced on-chain, and at what cost. We encode the tradability conditions of the 2023 resolution of the Shariah Advisory Council of the Securities Commission Malaysia on Sukuk Wakalah bi al-Istithmar as issuance and transfer policies that read EIP-712 claims, signed by separate institutional roles, about each asset's rights, valuation, encumbrance and Shariah classification and about the allocation of proceeds. translated_title: 代币化伊斯兰债券（Sukuk）：一种资产证据与可编程伊斯兰教法合规的可验证架构
translated_abstract: ERC-3643 等安全代币标准决定了谁可以持有代币，却无法决定代币背后代表什么。对于伊斯兰债券（sukuk）而言，这一缺口至关重要：一张凭证能否以协商价格交易取决于其投资组合的内容，而仅验证投资者身份的代币在所有非债务资产被出售后仍会继续交易。我们探讨这一可交易性条件能否在链上强制执行，以及其代价如何。我们将马来西亚证券委员会伊斯兰教法咨询委员会 2023 年关于投资代理伊斯兰债券决议中的可交易性条件，编码为读取 EIP-712 声明的发行与转让策略，这些声明由不同的机构角色分别签署，内容涵盖每项资产的权利、估值、负担情况、伊斯兰教法分类以及收益的分配。在我们基于合成工具构建的 26 个场景中，仅基于身份的基线错误地允许了编码策略所拒绝的 13 项操作，并且……
tldr: 本文提出一种代币化伊斯兰债券的可验证架构，将马来西亚证券委员会2023年伊斯兰教法决议中的可交易性条件编码为读取EIP-712签名资产声明的链上发行与转让策略，弥补了ERC-3643等安全代币标准只验证投资者身份、不验证底层资产证据与伊斯兰教法合规的关键缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a verifiable architecture for tokenised sukuk that encodes Shariah tradability conditions from the Malaysian SC's 2023 resolution as on-chain issuance and transfer policies reading EIP-712 signed asset claims, addressing the critical gap in security-token standards like ERC-3643 that verify only investor identity rather than underlying asset evidence and Shariah compliance.
